title: Black Gato Nightcap Recipe
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine all the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice and stir to chill. Strain into a rocks glass over a few cubes of ice or one large cube.
Coffee-Infused Mezcal: Add 1 scoop of espresso to a bottle of mezcal and let sit for  for 3-4 hours. Strain the coffee out of the bottle before use.
